result:
I wrote `component.html` in the finance folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and rendering are unchecked.

It's the full Invoices screen at 1280px inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS only. It has the "Invoices" heading, the "New Invoice" primary button, the All, Unpaid and Paid filters with All selected, and the five rows exactly as you gave them. I copied the tokens it uses from `tokens.css` into the file so it stands alone.

I followed the Look (v6) section of `DESIGN.md`, which overrides the older Screens rules where they differ:
- **Top of page:** a 6px accent bar, a 64px Unbounded Light title, and a 2px ink rule under the title row.
- **Table:** it sits flat on white with no card. The header row is ink with 44px height, and body rows are 64px with light dividers.
- **Numbers:** invoice numbers are 18px bold. Amounts are right-aligned, accent blue, 18px bold, in tabular figures so the decimals line up.
- **Status tags:** Unpaid has an ink outline, Paid has an accent fill, and Overdue has an ink fill.
- **Buttons:** dark pills, with the filters as the Secondary style.

- **Density:** the 64px rows and 64px title are looser than "dense, spreadsheet-like" might suggest. I followed the design file over the density cue. If Finance wants it tighter, the row height is the main thing to change.
- **Selected filter:** the design file doesn't define a selected state, so I gave "All" an accent-tint fill with accent text and border.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so on a machine without them the page falls back to system fonts.
- **Search field:** I left out the search field the Look section describes, since you asked for exactly this content.
